name: Exponential campaign progression: rising hordes, veteran upgrades and spores

references.name: Fresh campaign first wave is achievable
references.source: Player-confirmed achievable first wave and independent automatic calibration. This anchor qualifies opening-wave play only; later-route adequacy must be assessed separately.

expectations.scope: Fresh paid earned progression, three predeclared purchase strategies. Counts and peak release-density targets grow about 1.4x per level; actual player capacity must be probed from the earned snapshots. This is not a calibrated human difficulty rating.
expectations.controller_validity: Any pool/action/telemetry error invalidates the attempt. Grace advances and damaged victories remain explicit. Later walls require matched earned-profile placement/cadence/composition checks before balance conclusions.
expectations.family_schedule: Level1 virus only; bacteria from level2; real harpoon spores from level4.
expectations.independence: R7 evaluation seeds 1141021, 1151031 and 1161043 are declared before final cap-extension runtime qualification or campaign outcomes. Earlier R2–R6 development results remain separate. Training seed 901003, if used, is not an independent evaluation sample.

spore_policy_revision: Cytotoxic T is the third paid discovery in control/economy, available after L3 for the L4 spore introduction. Offense keeps its first-discovery T choice. Ordinary Antibody earnings and prerequisites apply; no grants. Original frozen campaign audit and revision2 development results retain the old orders.

training_protocol.freeze: Keep all three purchase priorities and controller parameters fixed before viewing held-out outcomes. Tune only using training runs; retain failed strategies in the held-out report.
training_protocol.interpretation: Separate experiment directories preserve split identity. These are conditional controller samples, not player skill percentiles.
training_protocol.input_revision: Selected 30 MC minimum reward, stat cost step 15, 0.85 baseline ATP per density, and level multipliers of 1 through level 4, then 0.75^(level-4). Opening wallets rise from 300 to 750; peak release pressure grows about 1.32x per level; Macrophages cost 35 ATP. Original V15 control and offense complete all ten levels. Economy alone receives a training-selected role-aware purchase priority; its fresh result and held-out evaluation are pending.

preregistration_amendments.scope: Seed allocation only; no priority, controller, gameplay, retry-budget or outcome-dependent selection change.
preregistration_amendments.reason: Campaign attempts use base_seed + attempt_index. The prior base values were closer than the maximum50attempts and could share numeric attempt seeds. New values separate all maximum50attempt ranges while retaining first-two selection and paired strategy seeds.

preregistration_amendments.scope: Training-selected income and economy purchase priority only. Control/offense priorities and all discovery orders/controller weights stay unchanged.
preregistration_amendments.reason: Original V15 control and offense at the selected income curve complete all ten levels. The stalled economy journey on level 7 resumes its earned bank of 68 MC and clears all nine waves after three 20-MC Macro role purchases. Move owned Macro throughput, reach and health before leak mitigation in fresh training, preserving previous failures and the original five-attempt bound.
preregistration_amendments.authorized_by: Root selection on training evidence; heldout remains unexecuted pending freshE training.

current_curve_declaration.scope: Current executable/config/level inputs define gameplay. Historical V15 training narratives below are superseded and are not execution controls.
current_curve_declaration.late_enemy_scaling: L1–L4 identity; from L5 durability 1.35^(level-4), damage 1.12^(level-4). Damage-derived ATP is divided by durability so toughness alone does not increase total kill income.
current_curve_declaration.family_schedule: Virus only on L1; bacteria from L2; spores from L4.
current_curve_declaration.upgrades: Firing and drain through rank 20, Macrophage work through 16, and shared Adaptive Memory through 20. Other health/support lines retain their useful caps.
current_curve_declaration.qualification: Native validity plus explicitly declared integrity, grace and denial criteria.
current_curve_declaration.metadata_cleanup: Historical narrative was relabelled after the R4 freeze. RunSpec, seeds, controller, priorities, metrics and thresholds are unchanged.
